fieldValues.title: Formatting toolbar
fieldValues.summary: When a paragraph is edited visually, a row of buttons under it formats the text: bold, italic, heading, bulleted and numbered lists, quote, link and code. A lit button means the format is on where the caret is; press it again to take it off. The link button asks for an address; leave it empty to remove a link. Markdown typing still works: **bold** or # at the start of a line format as you type.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Teach the buttons when the writer asks how to make text bold, a heading, a list, a quote or a link, or seems to be typing markdown by hand without knowing it. The toolbar shows only while a paragraph is edited visually; text is still saved as markdown. Point at it with ui_highlight. Never format the writer's text for them unless asked.
